implementation.public_path: Live rope resources execute the production realtime-single-step schedule instead of the former blanket PM_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT rejection.
implementation.fixed_tick: One 1/60 predictor, one common spatial build/query/publication, eight constraint/apply sweeps, contacts after sweeps 2/4/6/8 and one velocity commit. Legacy maximum_substep_timestep and solver_iterations do not alter the graph.
implementation.common_epoch: F8-10 swept rope segments occupy reserved ranges of the same published spatial epoch used by rigid, liquid, cloth and soft-body resources; the rope solve performs no rebuild, refit, sort or query.
implementation.attachment: The frozen F8-15 predictor consumes explicit endpoint targets. The installed production fixture proves an exact static rigid endpoint pin; moving rigid-target generation and reciprocal response remain F8-45.
implementation.collision_consumer: The four frozen F8-15 contact projections consume a cleared canonical per-node view. Rigid/rope contact generation and reciprocal exchange remain F8-45.
implementation.atomic_state: Positions and velocities publish only after successful resource, snapshot and spatial commit. Exact-limit failure leaves public bytes unchanged; replacement and reset renew generation/revision identity.
implementation.adapters: CPU, CUDA, Vulkan and Metal dispatch bindings call the common F8-10/F8-15 Slang entries; no adapter contains private rope equations.
